source.name: Deep Seasonal Color Analysis System (DSCAS)
source.license: No license declared upstream. Only the published method is adapted here; no DSCAS source code or model weights are copied.
source.adaptation: DSCAS segments the face with a trained network, thresholds four metrics into bits and picks one of four seasons. Silo instead localizes regions with Gemini, samples real pixels, and maps the same metrics to continuous warmth/depth/clarity. The app (not this server) picks the season.

caveats: DSCAS cutoffs were derived from its own segmentation and color-extraction pipeline on its own face dataset. They are uncalibrated for Gemini-localized, box-sampled inputs.
Spreads, weights, penalties, caps and sampling parameters are team-selected provisional starting values, not published DSCAS calibration.
Outputs are not clinically or scientifically validated. Confidence is an engineering heuristic, not a calibrated probability.

referenceColors.note: DSCAS compute_subtone: lips closer to peach in CIELAB = warm, closer to purple = cool.

metrics.subtone: CIELAB deltaE76 from the lip color to peach and to purple. Input: lips.
metrics.intensity: HSV saturation (0..1) of the skin color. Input: skin.
metrics.value: Mean HSV value (0..1) of skin, hair and iris colors, over those available. DSCAS uses skin + eyes when hair is missing; using skin + hair when eyes are missing, or skin alone, is a Silo adaptation.
metrics.contrast: |HSV value(hair) - HSV value(iris)|. Requires both hair and iris.

cutoffs.note: DSCAS UserPaletteClassificationFilter default thresholds (contrast, intensity, value) = (0.200, 0.422, 0.390), hand-picked from median values on its training data.

formulas.clarity: clamp(intensityWeight * (intensity - cutoffs.intensity) / intensitySpread + contrastWeight * (contrast - cutoffs.contrast) / contrastSpread, -1, 1); intensity term alone when contrast is unavailable

missingValueBehavior.skin: No usable face: respond 422 no_usable_face so the app offers retake or quiz-only.
missingValueBehavior.lips: Missing, unsampleable or makeup detected: warmth = 0, confidence capped at caps.lips.
missingValueBehavior.hair: Value from remaining regions, contrast unavailable, confidence capped at caps.hair.
missingValueBehavior.iris: Value from remaining regions, contrast unavailable, confidence capped at caps.iris.

confidence.note: Penalties are summed and subtracted from start, then the lowest applicable cap applies, then clamped to [0, 1]. questionableLocalization applies once if Gemini flags unreliable regions or a returned box fails plausibility checks. lipMakeup is not a penalty: it removes the lip sample, so the lips cap applies.

sampling.note: Provisional. Each box is shrunk by innerShrink per side, pixels whose R+G+B fall outside dscasPixelSumBounds are dropped (DSCAS discards too-dark/too-bright candidates the same way), the darkest trimDark and brightest trimBright fractions by luma are dropped to cut shadows and highlights, and the per-channel median of the rest is the region color. Iris trims more highlights to drop sclera and reflections.

plausibility.note: Provisional. skin, lips and iris centers must lie inside the face box; iris must sit above lips; any two of skin, lips, iris may not overlap by more than maxOverlapFraction of the smaller box.
